online_p: Amazon Prime Access waa {a} bishii. Walmart+ Assist waa {w} sannadkii. Instacart dukaamo badan kama qaado lacagta keenista ama qaadashada dalabyada EBT. Saddexdaba waxay rabaan inaad muujiso inaad hesho {snap} ama Medicaid.
online_note: EBT wuxuu bixiyaa cunto oo kaliya. Lacagta keenista, tiibka iyo canshuurta waxay u baahan yihiin kaar kale.
surplus_p: Too Good To Go wuxuu iibiyaa boorsooyin cuntada aan la iibin ee dukaamada iyo foornooyinka qiyaastii saddex meelood meel qiimaha. Flashfood wuxuu iibiyaa raashin taariikhdiisu dhow dahay qiimo dhimis weyn dukaamada la shaqeeya.
surplus_note: Flashfood wuxuu aqbalaa EBT Meijer, Tops, Giant Eagle, Lucky iyo Piggly Wiggly. Abkan waxaa maamula shirkado kale.
